units: <cite ref="Eruvin 61b:9">Erub. 61ᵇ</cite> <he>פ׳</he> thou disputer (Mar Judah)! <cite ref="Kiddushin 58a:5">Kidd. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>פַּלָּגָא איקמיינכי</he> that disputer (Mar Judah) has put you up to it.
<cite ref="Gittin 31b:10">Gitt. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>מקמי פ׳ ניקום</he> shall we rise for that querulous man (G’nibah)?
